articles.title: Carlsberg said to start road show for $600 million India IPO

Strong IPO demand in India supports the listing outlook, with Carlsberg India reporting robust revenue.

articles.title: Top pension fund to buy more India state bonds on high yields
articles.content: SBI Pension Fund plans to increase investments in state government bonds, expecting higher yields amid rising supply. The $64 billion fund is pursuing a carry-focused strategy, favouring state and corporate debt for steady income. It also plans to increase large-cap equity exposure while maintaining a cautious approach towards bond duration.

articles.title: India bonds under pressure before debt supply; hot inflation prints pinch further
articles.content: Indian government bonds experienced significant selling pressure ahead of a major auction for the benchmark paper. The yield on the 6.94% 2036 bond rose notably due to rising inflation in both India and the United States. The Reserve Bank of India is expected to raise interest rates again in early December due to persistent inflationary pressures. Moreover, US Treasury yields remained elevated as markets anticipate larger interest rate hikes.
